decisions.decision: Loaded Vibes is optimized for developer time saved and the usefulness of the generated repository, not governance breadth.
CLI, web configurator, and loadedvibes.json share one configuration schema and normalization path.

Loaded Vibes is the sole executable application-template authority and DevNotes is the Hipster Stack doctrine authority. DigitalHerencia/Vibes is not an upstream, reference, sync, provenance, packaging, or runtime dependency.
The final repository contains one maximal white-label application at template/. Generation copies that source, resolves ownership, removes excluded material, and applies structured transforms.

packages/recipes and duplicated templates/modules source are migration-era structures. Useful defaults and ownership semantics may be preserved, but the structures themselves are not the target architecture.
Presets, when retained, are convenience defaults over one configuration model and never represent separate templates or architectures.
A configuration option is user-selectable only when Loaded Vibes can make a real deterministic change to generated output or project lifecycle.
Loaded Vibes' website is a dark developer tool with separate landing, configure, and docs surfaces. The CLI remains the primary execution surface and the web configurator remains stateless.
Root docs/ is the canonical end-user documentation source. context/ remains maintainer/Codex context.
The migration adds no new tests or validation systems. Existing relevant checks may be run proportionally for the behavior changed by an Issue.

The LV-201 through LV-207 migration is complete. The final repository owns one template at template/, packages cli/core/schema, shared configuration semantics, the canonical loaded-vibes command, stateless web routes, and canonical end-user docs at docs/.

The owner-approved 2026-08-13 Constituter redesign supersedes older fixed-composition governance: architecture remains opinionated while providers, capabilities, authorization, routes, resources, and safe output policy move behind one canonical Application Definition and resolver. The web workbench is named The Constituter™.

The 2026-08-28 handoff authority establishes TypeScripture as doctrine, Codependent Coding as the Web App Architecture, Hipster Stack as the resolver/generator/CLI technology, Anthimeria as the stateless workbench, Virgule as the dependency-closed definition, Arrangement as generated output, and Loaded Vibes as post-generation Codex operations.

Nine Ontology normalized defaults replace the four generic presets as canonical starters; Simples contains only PureUI Blocks and BusinessLogic Blocks or Workflows; one shared resolver remains authoritative for CLI, config, Anthimeria preview, planning, and materialization.

The consolidation workspace is local implementation evidence, not a repository identity. Remote creation, push, publication, deployment, and credential provisioning remain deferred until owner acceptance.

Owner acceptance on 2026-08-28 authorized publication of the completed consolidation build to DigitalHerencia/CodependentCoding and production deployment through the existing digital-herencia/codependent-coding Vercel project at codependentcoding.vercel.app.
